facts.text: IU Bloomington charges a flat fee for tuition, allowing students to take up to 40 credit hours across fall, spring, and intersessions for the same cost.

sources.title: Cost of attendance for international undergraduate students
sources.quote: At IU Bloomington, you'll pay a flat fee for tuition. This means you will be able to take advantage of 40 credit hours across fall, spring, and our intersessions—for the same cost.
